description.content:
A FHIR R4-compliant REST API providing secure access to electronic health record data. Canvas Medical supports 41 FHIR resources (21 with write capabilities) covering clinical, administrative, financial, and care coordination domains. The API follows the HL7 FHIR R4 specification and supports OAuth 2.0 Client Credentials and Authorization Code flows with SMART on FHIR scopes for machine-to-machine and user-delegated access.
